title: Callaway 18-hole chart default grid correction + localStorage migration + placeholder rendering

requirements.summary: Update shipped 18-hole Callaway grid defaults to exactly match the provided 13×11 (row + five gross/deduction pairs) dataset while preserving the 13×5 grid + column adjustments model.
acceptanceCriteria: On a fresh install (no localStorage chart data), the 18-hole chart grid renders the exact gross/deduction values listed above (with placeholders where the user supplied zeros).
All worst-holes/deduction values support 0.5 increments and are stored without rounding.
No extra rows/columns are added or removed (13 rows, 5 chart columns, with row-number plus 10 value columns in the UI table).

file_operations.description: Ensure getDefault18GridChart() exactly matches the user-provided 13-row table values (including placeholder (0,0) cells and 0.5 increments) and continues to ship a 13×5 grid with 5 columnAdjustments.
Update the developer documentation to reflect the corrected 18-hole shipped defaults dataset and how placeholder (0,0) cells are represented in the grid.

requirements.summary: Automatically migrate existing localStorage charts that exactly equal the prior shipped 18-hole defaults so users receive the corrected shipped defaults without overwriting user-edited charts.
acceptanceCriteria: If localStorage contains the prior shipped 18-hole grid defaults, reloading the app results in the new shipped 18-hole defaults being used (without the user needing to manually reset).
If localStorage contains a user-edited chart that does NOT equal the prior shipped defaults, the app does not overwrite it.

file_operations.description: Harden the 18-hole localStorage migration logic to reliably detect when the stored active grid chart and/or stored user-default grid chart matches the prior shipped 18-hole defaults and remove only those entries so the new shipped defaults apply, without touching non-matching user edits.

requirements.summary: Render placeholder chart cells (grossScore=0 and worstHoles=0) as visually blank in chart grid UI while keeping persisted values as (0,0) and maintaining scoring behavior that ignores placeholders.
acceptanceCriteria: In the Callaway chart editor and any chart display table, cells whose grossScore and worstHoles are both 0 render as empty rather than showing “0”.
Saving the chart preserves placeholder cells as (0,0) values in persisted chart data.
Chart calculations continue to ignore placeholder grossScore=0 cells (i.e., placeholders do not affect scoring).

file_operations.description: Add a small helper (e.g., isPlaceholderCell / displayValueForCell) to centralize the rule that only (grossScore=0 && worstHoles=0) should render as an empty UI value while the underlying stored values remain numeric zeros.

Update the chart grid inputs to display empty values for placeholder cells (grossScore=0 and worstHoles=0) while ensuring clearing an input sets the underlying value back to 0 and saving persists placeholders as (0,0).
